summary: The FIFO asserts full at three entries instead of four.
reasoning: The memory has four entries, and the testbench expects full only when occupancy reaches four. The simulation fails with occupancy 3 and full=1. This is the most likely cause, though the proposed change has not been validated. Evidence: baseline:simulation; rtl/fifo.v lines 3, 8; tb/fifo_tb.v lines 13, 22.
